Name: King Jehoshaphat
Summary: Jehoshaphat was a faithful king of Judah who sent teachers of the Law throughout his kingdom and sought God in national crisis. His prayer in battle is one of Scripture's great models of trust.
KeyStory: Facing a vast invading army, Jehoshaphat prayed, We do not know what to do, but our eyes are on You — and God fought the battle as singers led the army.
LifeLesson: 'We do not know what to do, but our eyes are on You' is enough. When you run out of answers, fix your eyes on God and let worship lead the way into battle.
